test_title: PYST 3: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.**

The manager assured the employees that none of them __will be dismiss__.
solution: The correct answer is **'would be dismissed'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The given sentence is grammatically incorrect. • Here, **'would be dismissed' **should be used instead of **'will be dismiss'.** • The given sentence is in the** indirect speech.** • Hence, '**will**' changes into '**would**'. And '**dismiss**' changes into '**dismissed**'. • Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is** Option 1.** **Correct Answer:__** *The manager assured the employees that none of them **would be dismissed.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__** • दिया गया वाक्य व्याकरण की दृष्टि से गलत है। • यहां **'will be dismiss'** के बजाय** 'would be dismissed' **का इस्तेमाल किया जाना चाहिए। • दिया गया वाक्य **indirect** **speech** में है। • इसलिए,** 'will' 'would'** में बदल जाती है। और '**dismiss**' '**dismissed**' में बदल जाता है। • इसलिए, ऊपर वर्णित बिंदुओं के अनुसार, हम पाते हैं कि सही उत्तर** Option 1 **है। 10c:Teec, The correct answer is '**Satisfaction**'.
